paper_title: Axion dark matter search from terrestrial magnetic fields at extremely low frequencies
notes: Paper places a new 95% CL upper limit on axion-photon coupling g_agamma using long-term (2012-2022) terrestrial magnetic field data at Eskdalemuir observatory, exploiting axion-induced EM waves in the Schumann resonance band (0.3-30 Hz), assuming local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3. Only two exact numerical anchors are stated in the text: g_agamma <~ 4e-13 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 3e-14 eV (best limit, first Schumann resonance ~7.8 Hz) and g_agamma <~ 1.3e-11 GeV^-1 at 0.2630 Hz (m_a ~ 1.09e-15 eV). The remaining data points are approximate interpolations of the exclusion curve shape shown in Fig. 6 (limit spans ~1e-15 to 1e-13 eV, weakening at both mass ends, improving on CAST by up to two orders of magnitude). Actual curve is not tabulated; intermediate values are estimates with factor ~2-3 uncertainty.
